data.one_liner: A Dart client library for seamless Groq Cloud API integration and LLM chat sessions.
data.what_it_does: Allows Dart and Flutter applications to interact with the Groq Cloud API. It provides chat management, streaming responses, tool use support, audio transcription, and content moderation using Groq's models.
use_when: You want to integrate Groq language models into your Dart or Flutter application.
You need chat sessions with support for streaming, tool execution, and resource tracking.
avoid_when: You require an official package maintained directly by Groq.
You need multiple choices returned in Groq responses, which are not currently supported.
strengths: Intuitive chat session interface with streaming and tool usage support.
Includes audio transcription/translation and content moderation capabilities.
weaknesses: Independent project, not officially maintained by Groq.
Multiple choices in responses are not supported yet.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a Groq API key from the Groq Cloud console.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative solution for running language models.
